Resolves #20075

Closing a popup after one of its tabs was dragged into main no longer collapses main's dock layout. A component destroyed while a drag still ends can no longer write into the vdom template its class shares with every later instance.

The writer, from a setter trace of the operator's four steps: Audit's drop empties its own tabs node in the popup, and that projection destroys the node's tab header toolbar and button while `SortZone#processDragEnd` waits out its latch. Its owner and item restores then ran on the destroyed components. `Base#destroy` deletes an instance's own keys, so `updateStyle` wrote into the prototype's `_vdom`. `Neo.container.Base`'s template then carried `{flex: 'none', height: null, position: null, minWidth: null, width: null}` for every container created afterwards, and the close's return projection rebuilt main's shell from such containers. Two changes:
- The drag end restores nothing onto destroyed components: the base `SortZone` restores, and the tab header zone's delayed `cls` write.
- `Component#destroy` leaves the instance a private copy of its template. That also contains the other post-destroy writers the census found (defect-note).

Evidence: L3 (headless Chromium Neural Link e2e on `apps/workstation` + unit) → L3 required (a cross-window gesture and a popup close). Residual: AC-4, Residual-Owner: #20022.

Per §9 Strategic-Fit Step-Back:
- **Decision**: Approve
- **Rationale**: Resolves the final `v13.3.1` cut blocker (`#20075`) at both the offending caller and the root engine lifecycle invariant: `SortZone#processDragEnd` and `TabHeaderSortZone#processDragEnd` no longer restore `style`, `wrapperStyle`, or `cls` onto components destroyed while the drag-end latch awaited cross-window commit settlement, and `Component#destroy` assigns `me._vdom = Neo.clone(me._vdom, true)` after `super.destroy()` deletes own properties so any post-destroy config write lands on a dead instance copy rather than polluting `Class.prototype._vdom` for future instances.

**Peer-Review Opening:** Phenomenal detective work tracing the collapsed `main` dock layout after popup close (`#20075`) to `Base#destroy` deleting `owner._vdom` on the emptied popup toolbar so `SortZone#processDragEnd`'s late `owner.style = ownerStyle` write mutated `Neo.container.Base.prototype._vdom`! Stopping the drag-end restores on destroyed components while sealing `Component#destroy` with a detached `_vdom` clone fixes both the immediate bug and the entire class of post-destroy prototype VDOM template pollution.

### 🧭 Patch-Blind Premise Snapshot

*   **Inputs Read Before Patch:** Ticket `#20075` (including the `Measured Mechanism` update), changed-file list (`src/component/Base.mjs`, `src/draggable/container/SortZone.mjs`, `src/draggable/tab/header/toolbar/SortZone.mjs`, `test/playwright/unit/component/Base_PrototypePollution.spec.mjs`, `test/playwright/unit/draggable/container/SortZone.spec.mjs`, `test/playwright/e2e/workstation/WorkstationPopupTabDragNL.spec.mjs`), and `src/component/Base.mjs` (`L1395-L1450`).
*   **Expected Solution Shape:** Because `Neo.core.Base#destroy` deletes all own keys on an instance (`delete me._vdom`), any post-destroy config setter on a `Component` resolves `this._vdom` to `Class.prototype._vdom` and mutates the shared class template. `Component#destroy` must assign a detached clone (`me._vdom = Neo.clone(me._vdom, true)`) after `super.destroy()`, and `SortZone#processDragEnd` + `TabHeaderSortZone#processDragEnd` must guard `!owner.isDestroyed` / `!item.isDestroyed` / `!me.dragComponent.isDestroyed` before restoring styles or classes.
*   **Patch Verdict:** Matches the expected shape (`src/component/Base.mjs:1428`, `src/draggable/container/SortZone.mjs:621,631,654`, and `src/draggable/tab/header/toolbar/SortZone.mjs:119`).
